fields.normalization: potential quadratures at U0=1 V; every full-RF field is multiplied by voltage_V in run_v3.py

launches.energy_radius_grid_note: Adaptive/compact grid, not full Cartesian: 3.75-100 meV at 0.5-3 mm (10 meV pilot at 1-3 mm); 200/400 meV at 1-2 mm; 1-3 eV exploratory boundary launches at 1-2 mm.
launches.phase_and_azimuth_grid: regular deterministic launch states; explicitly recorded per job
launches.kinetic_energy_conversion: speed=sqrt(2*E_eV*e/m_physical); m/z uses Thomson and charge_state=1

solver.event: terminal outward crossing of r=8 mm

compute.checkpoint: append-only trajectory_checkpoint.jsonl plus per-job atomic checkpoints

interpretation.retention: finite-time 2D transverse survival inside 8 mm, not infinite-time stability or 3D transmission
interpretation.RF_off: exact analytical ballistic control at the identical physical horizon
interpretation.effective_model_E: diagnostic only; never classifies full-RF outcomes
interpretation.legacy_V1_V2_voltage_scaling: unit-voltage N48 was used without multiplying by the declared 250 V; actual field scale 1 V, pseudopotential factor 1/62500 of label
